sentences.text: The genus includes two species: Pseudodalatias barnstonensis and Pseudodalatias henarejensis.
The genus Pseudodalatias was described by Reif in 1978.
Pseudodalatias belongs to the monotypic family Pseudodalatiidae.
Scientists debate whether Pseudodalatias is a neoselachian or a hybodont.
This extinct cartilaginous fish lived in England, Italy, and Spain between 241.464 and 199.5 million years ago, from the Ladinian to the Hettangian stages.
